# Swagger UI distribution

These files come from the upstream `swagger-ui-dist` 5.36.0 package. BharatOS serves the
JavaScript bundle and stylesheet locally. The Apache 2.0 licence, notice and bundle licence
list are included here. [Upstream release](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui/releases/tag/v5.36.0) · [Distribution archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/swagger-ui-dist/-/swagger-ui-dist-5.36.0.tgz)

Registry integrity digest

```text
sha512-Lt6/Kb0gXmLdiabLhvso4VdJP9V7qJWB0zh0gzeXUV3+CMOTzMmvpJRSXN7EAjfwixwmoi9ezDbLHiexC7lA9A==
```

When updating, verify the new archive against its registry digest, copy the same files from the
distribution, and run the offline reference browser test.
